indicates how the track data is to be displayed. By default the entire track is displayed. However, you could display the locations of the start or end of the track or the location where the track reached a specified tracking time. These will be displayed as points.
Limit to current column, row and layer in 2D views:

If this checkbox is checked, only those time series that are in the current layer (top view), current row (front view) or current column (side view) will be displayed. Checking this checkbox helps keep the display from being hard to understand because too many time series are displayed. However, if a DISV model is used, all the cells are treated as being in a single column for the purposes of this check box.
This is the size in pixels at which single points will be displayed. Single points are used for the starting and ending locations and for specified track times.
